# Overview of Week 13 through Week 15

Class focused on reviewing group surveys in Qualtrics, preparing for the upcoming CEP presentations, and working with structural equation modeling (SEM) in Positron.

# Review Qualtrics #1–2

Dr Jung reviewed surveys created by different groups and discussed errors groups encountered. The review emphasized checking how the survey works from the respondent’s perspective.

Reminders for checking our group’s survey:

- Keep questions clear and avoid asking two things in one question.
- Make sure response choices match the question and use consistent scales.
- Test any display or skip logic so respondents see the appropriate questions.
- Preview the full survey, including different answer paths, before distributing it.
- Check required-response settings and whether the exported data will be usable for analysis.

The main takeaway is to test the survey as a participant instead of only reviewing it in the editor. Problems in the survey can create problems in the dataset later.

# Presentation

Dr Jung discussed the upcoming CEP presentation, expectations, and which groups will present on each day.

Preparation reminders:

- Explain the project’s purpose and the question the group is trying to answer.
- Connect the survey and analysis plan to the project objective.
- Organize slides so the audience can follow the project’s progress.
- Coordinate speaking roles and practice transitions between group members.
- Check the posted schedule and presentation guidelines for our group’s assigned date and exact requirements.

# SEM

SEM was demonstrated in Positron using an R script, including model specification and plots with semPlot.
